changelog.desc: Install intellij-idea-oss, Arch's new name for the community edition package.
Update docs and installer for the 0.4.0 release: web app and root key sign in, reverse proxy support, cluster peer port.

[Existing users should update:](https://github.com/linuxserver/docker-swag/blob/master/README.md#updating-configs) proxy.conf, authelia-server.conf, authentik-server.conf, tinyauth-server.conf - Update Nginx configuration to replace $http_host with $host$is_request_port$request_port for better compatibility.
Add krb5-libs for better postgresql support.
Add krb5-libs for better postgresql support.
Add krb5-libs for better postgresql support.
Add krb5-libs for better postgresql support.
Force OrcaSlicer to use the X11 GDK backend to fix UI rendering issues under Wayland.
Rebase to Alpine 3.24 with php 8.5. Tweak opcache settings according to upstream docs. Import upstream release notes in Github releases.
Update `develop` branch to v5. New v5 installs will write initial credentials to container log.
Rebase to Alpine 3.24, switch upstream repo to v2 maintenance repo.
Quality of life upgrades for KDE, MATE, and Xfce. Install base packages for flavors initialize KDE sessions properly.
Pin libtorrent to 2.0.13 due to deprecated function. Fix cron for GeoIP updates.
Updates for selkies v2, add X11 support.
Update for Selkies v2, default to X11 for cursor.
Updates for Selkies v2, add x11 init for ubuntu-kde, show ubuntu-lxqt branch.
Add fallback for legacy or misconfigured systems without IPv6 support.
Make seccomp and apparmor unconfined optional with proot-bwrap.
Update lib paths to fix hw transcoding.
Rebase to Ubuntu Resolute. Enable jemalloc to reduce memory footprint.
Rebase to Alpine 3.24. Compile on Alpine edge.
Use new X-Tinyauth-Location header in Tinyauth locations and remove duplicate auth module headers.
Install Sealskin from the upstream Python wheel, rebase to Alpine 3.24.
Make sure /config is only accessible by the PUID user.
Bake the p2p discovery sidecar into the image at build time (manifest-pinned, sha256-verified) so discovery works without runtime egress to GitHub.
Rebase to Alpine 3.23. Add python gdbm backend.
Switch to legacy repo until migration steps are figured out.
Fix NVIDIA passthrough to Workspace containers by generating a CDI specification inside the DinD layer.
Rebase to Ubuntu Resolute, install from ppa.
Run the async queue worker as the PUID/PGID-managed abc user.
Give kasm_manager a healthcheck start period so a cold start does not leave kasm_proxy created but never started.
Start ingesting head appimage again, add notes on using SDL for controller support.
Rebase to Alpine 3.24. Enable new UI with additional settings files available in the config folder.
Add support for Let's Encrypt cert profiles. Run certbot twice daily with a random delay.
Rebase to Alpine 3.24. Use the distro onnxruntime so the discovery/recommendation features work on musl.
